name: lukemcdonald.com
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm install 24; export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/$(nvm version 24)/bin:$PATH"; hash -r; corepack enable; corepack prepare pnpm@11.24.0 --activate; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

terminals.name: dev
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/$(nvm version 24)/bin:$PATH"; hash -r; corepack enable >/dev/null 2>&1; pnpm run dev
